quests.concept: Catch of the Day & Preparation Inquiries
quests.prepTerm: Pan-seared, Poached, Blackened, Ceviche, Aioli
quests.etiquetteTip: Ask about market price ("MP") and seasoning before ordering daily fresh catches.
quests.waiterPrompt: Tonight's market special is wild-caught sea bass. Are there any questions about how it is prepared?
quests.optimalOrderStatement: Could you tell me how the sea bass is seasoned, and whether the lemon-caper reduction is served on the side or over the fish?
quests.keyTakeaway: Inquiring about reductions and dressings allows you to tailor dish presentation without disrupting the recipe.

quests.prepTerm: Amuse-bouche, Entrée, Intermezzo (palate cleanser), Digestif
quests.etiquetteTip: Inform the staff if you prefer a relaxed or expedited pace for a multi-course dinner.
quests.waiterPrompt: We offer a seven-course chef's tasting menu. Are you prepared for approximately two hours of culinary service?
quests.optimalOrderStatement: Yes, that sounds wonderful. We are celebrating an anniversary tonight, so we would appreciate a relaxed, leisurely pace.
quests.keyTakeaway: Sharing the occasion and pace preference helps the brigade time each course to perfection.

quests.concept: Dressings on the Side & Ingredient Omissions
quests.prepTerm: Vinaigrette on the side, Extra virgin olive oil, Light drizzle
quests.etiquetteTip: Requesting dressings "on the side" is widely accepted; always use "on the side" rather than "in a bowl apart".
quests.waiterPrompt: The harvest arugula salad comes with candied pecans and goat cheese dressing. Is that acceptable for you?
quests.optimalOrderStatement: That sounds lovely, but could I please have the dressing served on the side, and pecans omitted?
quests.keyTakeaway: "On the side" and "omitted" are industry standard terms that servers can immediately key into the POS terminal.

quests.concept: Split Checks, Tip Etiquette & Payment Handling
quests.prepTerm: Split the bill evenly, Itemized check, Gratuity included
quests.etiquetteTip: Ask if checks can be split before payment, and check whether service charge is already included.
quests.waiterPrompt: Whenever you're ready, I have the check here for you. Would you like it all on one card?
quests.optimalOrderStatement: Thank you! Could we please split the bill evenly between these two credit cards? And is gratuity already included?
quests.keyTakeaway: Clarifying gratuity and card division upfront prevents confusion and delays at departure.

quests.prepTerm: Tap vs. Sparkling Water / Draft vs. Bottled
quests.etiquetteTip: Specify water and beverage choices promptly using courteous modals ("May we start with...", "Could we get...").
quests.waiterPrompt: Good evening, welcome to the Bistro! Can I start you off with something to drink while you look over the menu?
quests.optimalOrderStatement: Good evening! Could we please start with a bottle of sparkling water with lime, and two draft lagers?
quests.keyTakeaway: Polite requests frame the entire service interaction smoothly.

quests.prepTerm: Tannins, Acidity, Vintage, Full-bodied vs. Crisp
quests.etiquetteTip: Seek sommelier recommendations by describing flavor notes you enjoy rather than guessing blindly.
quests.waiterPrompt: Would you care for wine pairings tonight, or should I recommend a vintage for your braised beef cheek?
quests.optimalOrderStatement: We would love a recommendation. We generally prefer full-bodied reds with low acidity and subtle oak notes.
quests.keyTakeaway: Specifying preferences (body, acidity, tannin) empowers the sommelier to suggest the ideal match.

quests.prepTerm: Gluten-sensitive, Celiac-safe, Nut-free, Dedicated Cookware
quests.etiquetteTip: State severe allergies explicitly at the beginning of the meal so the kitchen can use sanitized surfaces.
quests.waiterPrompt: Before taking your orders, does anyone at the table have dietary restrictions or food allergies we should note?
quests.optimalOrderStatement: Yes, thank you for checking. I have a severe peanut allergy. Could you please confirm if this sauce has any nut paste or traces?
quests.keyTakeaway: Clear, polite statements about allergies protect your health and allow the culinary team to sanitize prep stations.

quests.prepTerm: Rare, Medium-rare (warm red center), Medium-well, Char-grilled
quests.etiquetteTip: Specify desired doneness clearly and request side substitutions conditionally ("Would it be possible to swap...").
quests.waiterPrompt: And how would you like the ribeye prepared, and would you like truffle fries or roasted asparagus as your side?
quests.optimalOrderStatement: I would like it medium-rare, please. And would it be possible to substitute the truffle fries with roasted asparagus?
quests.keyTakeaway: "Would it be possible to substitute..." is the universal gold standard for polite culinary adjustments.
